1000769751422.alt_text: Blue Jacob Cohen jeans folded to show back pocket with curved stitching and brown embossed logo patch
1000769751422.description: Folded mid-blue washed Jacob Cohen jeans shown from the back, with a patch pocket featuring curved tan contrast stitching. A brown leather-look patch with a geometric embossed pattern and Jacob Cohen wordmark sits on the waistband.

1003749286954.alt_text: Black Parajumpers hybrid puffer jacket with quilted front, knit sleeves, hood and logo patch on left sleeve
1003749286954.description: Black Parajumpers hooded jacket with a quilted puffer front panel, knit sleeves and sides, and a two-way silver front zip. It has a diagonal zip chest pocket, a yellow tab at the collar and a round logo patch on the upper sleeve.

1004752923420.alt_text: Navy Parajumpers puffer gilet with high collar, full zip and yellow tab at the neck
1004752923420.description: Navy glossy quilted puffer gilet with horizontal baffles, a high stand collar and a full-length silver zip. Details include a yellow tab and orange loop at the collar, a small logo patch near the neck and zipped side pockets.

1012045472683.alt_text: Light blue Moncler jeans with brown leather logo patch and round logo badge on back pocket
1012045472683.description: Light blue washed denim jeans shown folded, with a brown leather waistband patch embossed with the Moncler logo and contrast tan stitching. The back pocket has red, white and blue stitched detailing and a round Moncler logo badge.

1013996099437.alt_text: Grey Ralph Lauren zip hoodie with small navy pony logo on the chest and matching drawstrings
1013996099437.description: Heather grey zip hoodie with a full-length silver-tone zip, drawstring hood and a split kangaroo pocket. A small navy pony logo sits on the left chest, with ribbed cuffs and hem and a navy neck label.

1017095869234.alt_text: Grey Burberry zip-up hoodie with tan check lined hood and drawstrings
1017095869234.description: Grey zip-up hoodie with raglan sleeves, a full-length front zip, kangaroo-style pockets and ribbed cuffs and hem. The hood is lined with tan and black check and has dark drawstrings, with a Burberry label visible inside the neck.

1019651039477.alt_text: Grey Ralph Lauren pullover hoodie with small navy pony logo on the chest and cream drawstrings
1019651039477.description: Heather grey Ralph Lauren pullover hoodie with a small navy embroidered pony logo on the left chest and cream drawstrings. It has a kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a blue Polo label inside the hood.

1023952915683.alt_text: White Acne Studios t-shirt with grey Acne Studios Stockholm 1996 text print across the chest
1023952915683.description: White short sleeve crewneck t-shirt with a large grey Acne Studios Stockholm 1996 wordmark printed across the chest. The tee has a ribbed collar, dropped shoulders and a brand label at the neck.

1030241651010.alt_text: Black Burberry zip hoodie with check-lined hood and small tonal logo on the chest
1030241651010.description: Black zip hoodie with a full-length zip, drawstring hood lined in beige check and a small tonal embroidered logo on the chest. It has side pockets, ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem.

1037820695821.alt_text: Silver Rolex watch with white dial, green crown logo and scattered handwritten green numerals
1037820695821.description: Silver Rolex watch with a link bracelet, smooth bezel and a white dial showing a green crown logo and the handwritten text Who cares I'm already late. Green numerals are scattered at the bottom of the dial, with a date window at three o'clock.

1071986485754.alt_text: Navy Nike wide leg sweatpants with small white swoosh logo on the upper thigh
1071986485754.description: Navy Nike sweatpants shown on a model with a wide leg cut and a relaxed drape over the shoes. A small white swoosh logo sits on the upper left thigh, with side pockets at the hips.

4234052477.alt_text: Black Hermes leather glove with silver-tone H logo plaque at the cuff
4234052477.description: Black leather glove shown palm side with a separately stitched thumb and a contrast-stitched cuff band. A small silver-tone H emblem sits on the cuff near the wrist.

4454131329.alt_text: Navy Loro Piana single-breasted coat with notch lapels, three buttons and flap pockets, shown in two pieces
4454131329.description: Two navy single-breasted coats with notch lapels, three dark buttons and large flap patch pockets, hung side by side. Each has a Loro Piana neck label and a brown hang tag on the inside.

5738118972.alt_text: Navy Brunello Cucinelli crewneck sweater shown from the back with grey elbow patches
5738118972.description: Back view of a navy knit crewneck sweater with grey oval elbow patches on both sleeves. It has ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem, with no logo visible.

6406833678.alt_text: Black Montblanc pen with silver clip, rings and end cap with white star emblem on the cap top
6406833678.description: Black Montblanc pen shown lying horizontally with a glossy black barrel and cap. Silver-tone clip, centre rings and end piece, with the white star emblem on top of the cap.

670236763544.alt_text: Navy Burberry zip hoodie with check-lined hood, drawstrings and brass-tone zip
670236763544.description: Navy zip hoodie from Burberry with a hood lined in black and white check and contrast drawstrings. It has a full brass-tone zip, raglan sleeves, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a Burberry neck label visible inside.

6716583439.alt_text: Navy Golden Goose Super-Star suede sneaker with cream star patch and distressed cream sole
6716583439.description: Navy suede low-top Golden Goose Super-Star sneaker with a cream leather star on the side, cream laces and a cream heel tab. Gold GGDB/SSTAR lettering sits on the side above a distressed cream rubber sole.

674945610775.alt_text: Brown Pampeano leather polo belt with navy and cream embroidered diamond pattern and brass buckle
674945610775.description: Brown leather belt with navy and cream embroidered stripes featuring a stepped diamond pattern, shown coiled. It has a brass square buckle and a brown leather keeper loop.

677989357267.alt_text: Cream Patagonia fleece vest with navy chest pocket and trim and small logo patches
677989357267.description: Cream Patagonia pile fleece gilet with a full front zip, stand collar and navy binding around the armholes and hem. A navy zip chest pocket carries a small logo patch, with two zip hand pockets and blue zip pulls.

7018439280.alt_text: Navy Brunello Cucinelli ribbed knit shawl collar cardigan with six buttons and white neck label
7018439280.description: Navy ribbed knit cardigan with a shawl collar, six-button front, raglan sleeves and ribbed cuffs and hem. A white Brunello Cucinelli label with red trim sits inside the neck.

7231806587.alt_text: Grey Saint Laurent hoodie with faded red stripes, SL crest and wordmark print on the chest
7231806587.description: Charcoal grey pullover hoodie with drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem. The front shows a distressed Saint Laurent wordmark above red and off-white stripes with a circular SL crest.

724216889678.alt_text: Black Burberry hooded puffer jacket with check-lined hood and small logo patch on the sleeve
724216889678.description: Black quilted Burberry puffer jacket with a hood lined in black, white and grey check, a snap-button front placket and two vertical zip pockets. A small logo patch sits on the upper left sleeve and a brown swing tag hangs at the front.

7246750960.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren quarter zip pullover with small tan pony logo on the chest
7246750960.description: Navy Ralph Lauren quarter zip pullover with a stand collar, silver-tone zip with brown leather pull and a small tan pony logo on the chest. It has long sleeves with ribbed cuffs and a blue Polo Ralph Lauren label inside the neck.

740333013030.alt_text: Cream Maison Margiela ribbed knit zip-up cardigan with high funnel collar and silver zip
740333013030.description: Cream ribbed knit full-zip cardigan from Maison Margiela with a high stand collar and a silver zip with a dark pull tab. It has ribbed cuffs and hem, and no logo is visible from the front.

7447925231.alt_text: Black Lanvin low-top sneaker with suede upper, patent toe cap and white rubber cupsole
7447925231.description: Black Lanvin low-top sneaker with a suede upper, glossy patent toe cap and black laces through metal eyelets. It sits on a thick white cupsole with a stitched edge.

746801458197.alt_text: Beige Maison Margiela ribbed knit crewneck sweater with white numbered label at the inside neck
746801458197.description: Beige ribbed knit crewneck sweater from Maison Margiela with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem. A white numbered brand label is visible inside the back neck.

7549271158.alt_text: Grey Stone Island knit cardigan with high button collar and black compass badge on the left sleeve
7549271158.description: Grey ribbed knit cardigan with a high stand collar, black button front and ribbed cuffs and hem. A black Stone Island compass badge sits on the left upper sleeve, with a brand label at the neck.

7563973209.alt_text: Black Maison Margiela low-top sneaker with smooth leather, suede overlays, cream laces and gum sole
7563973209.description: Black low-top Maison Margiela sneaker shown in side profile, with smooth leather panels and black suede overlays on the toe, eyestay, heel and side. It has cream laces, a light lining and a tan gum rubber cupsole.

7578520838.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren ribbed knit shawl collar cardigan with brown buttons and two front patch pockets
7578520838.description: Navy Ralph Lauren cardigan in a ribbed knit with a shawl collar, five brown buttons down the front and two patch pockets at the hem. A Polo by Ralph Lauren label is visible inside the neck.

7584191861.alt_text: Grey Nike Tech Fleece tracksuit with full zip hoodie and joggers, black zips and small black logos
7584191861.description: Grey Nike Tech Fleece tracksuit with a full zip hooded jacket, black zip pockets and a small black logo on the chest. The matching joggers have a zip pocket on the thigh and a small black logo, shown on hangers with a cream garment behind.

760438413422.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren crewneck sweater with small red pony logo on the chest
760438413422.description: Navy knit crewneck sweater with a small red embroidered pony logo on the left chest. It has ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, and a blue Polo Ralph Lauren neck label.

7630051831.alt_text: Black Acne Studios long sleeve t-shirt with distressed white Acne Studios Stockholm 1996 print on the chest
7630051831.description: Black Acne Studios long sleeve t-shirt with a crew neck and a white neck label. The front has a large faded white print reading Acne Studios Stockholm 1996 across the chest.

7637266629.alt_text: Grey Stone Island chunky rib knit zip hoodie with compass badge on the left sleeve
7637266629.description: Grey ribbed knit hoodie with a full-length black two-way zip, attached hood and two front patch pockets. A black Stone Island compass badge sits on the left sleeve, with ribbed cuffs and hem.

7643072971.alt_text: Silver Rolex Datejust style watch with white dial, blue scattered numerals and Who cares I'm already late text
7643072971.description: Silver watch with a fluted bezel, jubilee style link bracelet and a white dial showing blue handwritten numerals tumbling to the bottom and the text Who cares I'm already late. A date window sits at three o'clock beside the blue and black hands.

7643237807.alt_text: Navy Tom Ford low-top suede sneaker with cream side stripe and cream rubber sole
7643237807.description: Navy low-top Tom Ford sneaker in suede with a cream zigzag-edged side stripe and navy laces. It sits on a thick cream cupsole with a small dark logo tab at the heel.

7645975387.alt_text: Green Rolex Submariner style wall clock with silver fluted rim, green bezel and white hour markers
7645975387.description: Round green wall clock styled as a Rolex Submariner, with a silver fluted outer rim, green numbered bezel and white luminous-style markers. The dial shows Submariner text, a date window at three o'clock and silver hands.

7647547734.alt_text: Navy and cream striped Ralph Lauren rugby shirt with small red pony logo on the chest
7647547734.description: Navy and cream wide-striped long sleeve rugby shirt with a cream collar, two-button placket and navy cuffs. A small red pony logo sits on the chest and a Polo by Ralph Lauren label is inside the collar.

7657202943.alt_text: Grey Essentials sweatpants with black Essentials Fear of God wordmark on the upper leg and drawstring waist
7657202943.description: Heather grey Essentials sweatpants shown folded from the side with an elasticated waistband and long drawstring. A black Essentials Fear of God wordmark sits on the upper left leg.

7663734281.alt_text: Navy Loro Piana field jacket with stand collar, four flap pockets and grey lined interior with logo label
7663734281.description: Navy field jacket with a high stand collar, concealed front zip and placket, and four flap pockets on the chest and hips. The grey lined collar interior shows a black Loro Piana label with a gold logo, and the waist has a drawstring.

7685030762.alt_text: Light blue Levis 511 jeans in a faded vintage wash with frayed raw hems
7685030762.description: Light blue Levis 511 jeans in a faded wash with whiskering at the hips and a five-pocket layout. They have a button fly front, belt loops, a straight leg and frayed raw hems, with a tag attached at the waist.

7706119313.alt_text: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with gold logo on the chest and two vertical zip chest pockets
7706119313.description: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with a full-length front zip and two vertical zipped chest pockets. A gold Arc'teryx logo and wordmark sit on the chest, with a zip on the sleeve and adjustable cuffs.

7708706458.alt_text: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with grey logo on the chest and zipped chest pockets
7708706458.description: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with a full front zip, two vertical zipped chest pockets and a zipped sleeve pocket. A small grey bird logo and wordmark sit on the chest.

7709125264.alt_text: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with grey bird logo on the chest and zipped chest pockets
7709125264.description: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with a full-length front zip and two vertical zipped chest pockets. A small grey bird logo sits on the left chest, with a wordmark label inside the collar.

7709297628.alt_text: Olive green Barbour wax jacket with brown corduroy collar, brass snap buttons and flap pockets
7709297628.description: Olive green Barbour wax jacket with a brown corduroy collar, concealed front zip with brass snap placket and a D-ring on the chest. It has two large flap pockets with snaps, raglan sleeves and snap-tab cuffs, with a small brand label inside the collar.

7710915428.alt_text: Tan UGG Tasman suede slipper with embroidered braided collar trim and debossed side logo
7710915428.description: Tan suede UGG Tasman slip-on slipper shown in side profile with a brown, white and orange braided embroidered collar. It has a debossed UGG logo on the side and a chunky treaded rubber-look sole.

7717948513.alt_text: Black Burberry check scarf with white, grey and red check pattern and fringed ends
7717948513.description: Black Burberry scarf with a large white, grey and red check pattern and fringed tassel ends. A small white Burberry label is stitched near one end.

7720193538.alt_text: White Golden Goose low-top sneakers with black star on the side and black heel tab
7720193538.description: White low-top lace-up sneakers with a black star patch on the side, perforated toe and side panels, and a black heel tab. The shoes sit on a distressed beige rubber sole with a black number print on the heel.

7725706759.alt_text: Grey and black Acne Studios check scarf with fringed ends and white logo patch
7725706759.description: Grey and black large check scarf with a brushed, fluffy surface and fringed ends. A white rectangular Acne Studios logo patch sits near the lower end.

7728108867.alt_text: Grey Patagonia full zip fleece vest with chest zip pocket and small logo patch on the chest
7728108867.description: Heathered grey Patagonia fleece gilet with a full-length zip, stand collar and darker grey trim. It has a vertical zip chest pocket with a small logo patch, two zip hand pockets and a logo label inside the collar.

7728142549.alt_text: Blue Ralph Lauren faded wash jeans shown from the back with RRL-style leather patch and whiskered fading
7728142549.description: Blue straight leg Ralph Lauren jeans shown from the back with heavy faded wash, whiskering on the thighs and honeycomb fading behind the knees. Details include two rear patch pockets, belt loops and a tan leather patch reading RR on the waistband.

7728738210.alt_text: Black Arc'teryx hooded shell jacket with grey bird logo on the chest and full front zip
7728738210.description: Black Arc'teryx hooded jacket with a full-length front zip, chest yoke panel and a grey bird logo on the left chest. It has a zip pocket on the upper sleeve, hidden hand pockets and cuffed sleeves.

7728872131.alt_text: White Saint Laurent low-top sneaker with red embroidered logo on the side and red heel tab
7728872131.description: White low-top leather sneaker with cream laces and a red Saint Laurent script logo embroidered on the side. It has a red heel tab, red-lined eyelet and a cream textured rubber cupsole.

7731148188.alt_text: Navy Christian Louboutin low-top suede sneaker with tonal laces and matching navy rubber sole
7731148188.description: Navy low-top sneaker in suede with tonal laces, a toe cap panel and a padded heel collar. It sits on a matching navy flat sole with no visible logo from this side view.

773708784961.alt_text: Blue Saint Laurent washed denim jeans folded to show back pocket and brown leather patch with metal YSL logo
773708784961.description: Folded blue washed denim jeans with a back patch pocket, light distressing and contrast stitching. A brown leather waistband patch carries a metal YSL monogram and Saint Laurent wordmark.

7739786803.alt_text: Silver Lacoste link bracelet with engraved crocodile logo on the clasp and textured petit pique links
7739786803.description: Silver metal link bracelet from Lacoste with alternating plain and textured cross-hatch links. The fold-over clasp at the centre carries an engraved crocodile logo.

7741721423.alt_text: Olive quilted zip vest with diamond stitching, stand collar and Barbour label at the neck
7741721423.description: Olive green diamond-quilted vest with a full front zip, ribbed stand collar and two patch pockets at the hem. The neck label shows Barbour branding with a check lining visible, although the listing names Burberry.

7755303278.alt_text: Light blue Ralph Lauren faded jeans with brown leather back patch and small metal pony on the back pocket
7755303278.description: Folded light blue faded denim jeans shown from the back, with light distressing on the back pocket and a brown leather waistband patch printed with a pony and POLO. A small metal pony emblem sits on the edge of the right back pocket.

7766598269.alt_text: Blue Maison Margiela suede and leather low-top sneakers with cream laces, top view
7766598269.description: Pair of blue low-top sneakers shown from above, with suede overlays, smooth leather panels and wide cream laces. Cream insoles carry a white label, the tongue shows printed numbers and a gum sole edge is visible.

7774498099.alt_text: White Acne Studios hoodie, back view with large grey Acne Studios Stockholm 1996 text print
7774498099.description: Back view of a white Acne Studios pullover hoodie with a large grey Acne Studios Stockholm 1996 wordmark printed across the back. It has a lined hood, ribbed cuffs and a ribbed hem.

7778357144.alt_text: Pink, purple and black Louis Vuitton perfume bottles in an open white monogram gift box with orange edge
7778357144.description: Three Louis Vuitton eau de parfum bottles labelled City of Stars, California and Les Sables Roses sit in an open white box. The lid shows the LV logo on a grey monogram print with an orange border and 3 x 30 ml marking.

7778392674.alt_text: Grey Moncler quilted down jacket with ribbed knit sleeves and collar and logo patch on the left sleeve
7778392674.description: Grey Moncler zip-up jacket with a diamond and horizontal quilted down front, ribbed knit sleeves and high knit collar. It has two side welt pockets, a two-way front zip and a white logo patch on the left sleeve.

7782160220.alt_text: Grey Loro Piana field jacket with spread collar, snap front and two flap chest-level hip pockets
7782160220.description: Grey-blue Loro Piana jacket with a spread collar, zip and snap button front, raglan sleeves and snap cuff tabs. It has two large flap pockets at the hip, a zip chest pocket, a branded neck label and an orange hang tag.

7787996631.alt_text: White Ralph Lauren crewneck sweatshirt with Polo Bear print in Hawaiian shirt and sunglasses on the front
7787996631.description: White crewneck sweatshirt with a front print of the Polo Bear wearing sunglasses, a floral Hawaiian shirt, white trousers and orange shoes. Polo Bear by Ralph Lauren text and signature sit below the print, with ribbed cuffs, hem and a navy neck label.

7790144072.alt_text: Black Chrome Hearts zip hoodie with white cross emblem on the chest and floral cross prints down both sleeves
7790144072.description: Black Chrome Hearts zip hoodie with a drawstring hood, silver full-length zip and kangaroo pockets. It has a white cross emblem on the left chest, white cross graphics along both sleeves and a CH logo near the hem.

7791151810.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren zip hoodie with small white pony logo on the chest and silver zip
7791151810.description: Navy full-zip hoodie with a silver zip, white-tipped drawstrings, split kangaroo pockets and ribbed cuffs and hem. A small white pony logo is embroidered on the left chest and a Polo label sits inside the hood.

7791483300.alt_text: Black Tom Ford rectangular sunglasses with light blue lenses and gold T hinge details, shown with brown box
7791483300.description: Black rectangular Tom Ford sunglasses with light blue tinted lenses, gold T details at the hinges and a Tom Ford wordmark on the arm. Shown in front of a brown branded box with an orange cleaning cloth.

7801851389.alt_text: Navy Tom Ford jeans with dark leather logo patch on the waistband and brown hang tag
7801851389.description: Dark blue Tom Ford denim jeans shown folded on a wooden hanger, with a dark leather logo patch at the back waistband and contrast stitching. A small TF emblem tab sits by the back pocket and a brown TF hang tag is attached.

7843021775.alt_text: Black Moncler hooded down jacket with quilted front panel, knit sleeves and round logo patch on the sleeve
7843021775.description: Black Moncler hooded jacket with a quilted down front, ribbed knit sleeves and a full-length two-way zip with zipped hand pockets. A round logo patch sits on the upper sleeve and lettering is quilted into the hood.

7852361579.alt_text: Grey Moncler hooded puffer jacket with quilted front and ribbed knit sleeves, logo patch on the sleeve
7852361579.description: Grey Moncler hooded jacket with a quilted puffer front, two-way zip, snap side pockets and ribbed knit sleeves, cuffs and hem. A zip pocket and round logo patch sit on the upper left sleeve.

798075690797.alt_text: Light blue Maison Margiela low-top sneakers with grey suede overlays, cream laces and gum soles
798075690797.description: A pair of light blue low-top sneakers in the German army trainer style with grey suede toe, eyelet and heel overlays. They have cream flat laces, a cream lining and gum rubber soles.

805059071491.alt_text: Grey Goyard card holder with all-over chevron monogram print and embossed Goyard Paris wordmark
805059071491.description: Grey Goyard card holder with an all-over chevron monogram print in grey and white. Smooth grey upper panel with embossed Goyard Paris wordmark and visible card slots.

829815347538.alt_text: Grey Ralph Lauren hoodie with large black pony and script signature logo on the front
829815347538.description: Heather grey pullover hoodie with white drawstrings, a kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem. The front has a large black sketched pony logo over a Ralph Lauren script signature, with a blue Polo label inside the hood.

837655077198.alt_text: Black Moncler hooded puffer jacket with snap button front and logo patch on the left sleeve
837655077198.description: Black Moncler puffer jacket with a quilted body, attached drawstring hood and snap button front placket. It has vertical side pockets, a sleeve pocket with a round logo patch and snap cuffs.

844207943975.alt_text: White Philippe Model low-top sneaker with black heel tab, shield logo patch and distressed grey sole
844207943975.description: White low-top lace-up sneaker with a shield logo patch outlined in black on the side, a black heel tab and pale grey suede toe and collar panels. The rubber cupsole has a worn grey finish with FM/78 lettering near the heel.

846177667601.alt_text: Grey Maison Margiela ribbed knit quarter zip sweater with high collar and silver-tone zip
846177667601.description: Grey ribbed knit quarter zip with a high stand collar and a silver-tone zip pull. The white Maison Margiela number label shows inside the neck, with ribbed cuffs and hem.

850449003937.alt_text: Grey Maison Margiela ribbed knit zip cardigan with high funnel collar and numbered label at the neck
850449003937.description: Grey ribbed knit cardigan with a full-length silver-tone zip, high funnel collar and ribbed cuffs and hem. The Maison Margiela numbered label is visible inside the back neck.

867265954871.alt_text: Silver Rolex Datejust watch with grey dial, fluted bezel and jubilee bracelet
867265954871.description: Silver Rolex Oyster Perpetual Datejust watch with a grey sunburst dial, baton hour markers and a date window at three o'clock. It has a fluted bezel, a crown logo on the dial and a five-link jubilee-style metal bracelet.

891428294916.alt_text: Grey Ralph Lauren cable knit crewneck sweater with small navy pony logo on the chest
891428294916.description: Grey cable knit crewneck sweater with a small navy embroidered pony logo on the left chest and a blue Polo Ralph Lauren neck label. It has ribbed trims at the collar, cuffs and hem.

893315757292.alt_text: Black Stone Island zip overshirt jacket with flap chest pocket and compass badge on the left sleeve
893315757292.description: Black zip-front overshirt jacket with a point collar, a single flap chest pocket and buttoned cuffs. The Stone Island compass badge is attached to the left sleeve and a brand label sits inside the collar.

894876922963.alt_text: Grey Fear of God Essentials hoodie shown from the back with black Essentials Fear of God wordmark
894876922963.description: Heather grey pullover hoodie shown from the back, with a large black Essentials Fear of God wordmark across the upper back. It has dropped shoulders, a small dark tab at the hood seam and ribbed cuffs and hem.

895235103982.alt_text: Navy Jacob Cohen jeans folded with brown lattice leather back patch, orange hang tag and branded band
895235103982.description: Folded navy blue Jacob Cohen jeans shown from the back with a brown perforated leather patch, back pocket and blue logo label at the waistband. An orange hang tag, white size tag and brown branded paper band are attached.

895532103700.alt_text: Dark blue Jacob Cohen straight leg jeans with faded whiskering and small light blue logo by the coin pocket
895532103700.description: Dark blue Jacob Cohen jeans in a straight leg cut with light fading on the thighs and knees. Details include a button fly, five pocket layout, a small light blue emblem near the coin pocket and a black waistband label.

898117225714.alt_text: Light blue Acne Studios long sleeve t-shirt with navy Stockholm 1996 text print across the chest
898117225714.description: Light blue Acne Studios long sleeve t-shirt with a crew neck and plain cuffs. The chest carries a large navy print reading Acne Studios Stockholm 1996.

918932928316.alt_text: White Maison Margiela low-top sneaker with black paint splatter and black dipped toe
918932928316.description: White low-top Maison Margiela sneaker with white laces and panelled upper. Black paint splatter spreads across the side towards a black toe cap and black sole section at the front.

926432872742.alt_text: Black Stone Island hooded button up jacket with compass badge on the left sleeve
926432872742.description: Black Stone Island button up jacket with a drawstring hood and two buttoned flap chest pockets. The compass badge sits on the left sleeve and a white label shows inside the neck.

935096845323.alt_text: Silver AP Royal Oak watch with green textured dial, octagonal bezel and integrated link bracelet
935096845323.description: Silver AP Royal Oak watch with an octagonal bezel fixed by eight hexagonal screws and an integrated link bracelet. The green grid-textured dial has white baton hour markers, a date window at three o'clock and the Audemars Piguet wordmark.

944338225566.alt_text: Light blue CP Company hooded puffer jacket with quilted panels and round lens badge on the sleeve
944338225566.description: Washed light blue CP Company puffer jacket with a hood, square quilting, a full front zip and two diagonal zip pockets. The left sleeve carries the round lens badge, with elastic cuffs and a drawcord hem.

945290516328.alt_text: Gold and red Hermes Clic bangle bracelet with a central H-shaped clasp
945290516328.description: Gold-tone bangle bracelet with red enamel panels on either side. A large H-shaped clasp sits at the centre front, as listed for the Hermes Clic bracelet.

950754050761.alt_text: Silver Rimowa hard-shell suitcase with grooved panels, top handle and four spinner wheels
950754050761.description: Silver Rimowa suitcase with vertical grooved shell, reinforced corners and a top carry handle above a small Rimowa logo plate. It sits on four black spinner wheels and is listed as a 21 inch size.

953406678555.alt_text: Black Louis Vuitton Keepall duffel bag with grey monogram print, black handles and detachable shoulder strap
953406678555.description: Black Louis Vuitton Keepall duffel bag with an all-over grey monogram print and black trim. It has twin rolled top handles, a padlock on the zip, a luggage tag and an adjustable shoulder strap with silver-tone hardware.

960508930674.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren zip hoodie with large white pony logo on the chest and number 2 on the sleeve
960508930674.description: Navy full-zip hoodie with a silver-tone zip, white drawstrings and a front kangaroo pocket split by the zip. A large white Big Pony logo sits on the left chest, a white number 2 is on the sleeve and a Polo Ralph Lauren label is at the neck.

963022778927.alt_text: Grey Ralph Lauren quarter zip sweater with small multicoloured pony logo on the chest
963022778927.description: Heather grey quarter zip sweater with a stand collar, silver-tone zip with a brown leather-look pull and ribbed cuffs. A small multicoloured pony logo sits on the left chest and a blue Polo Ralph Lauren label is inside the neck.

964484272869.alt_text: White Ralph Lauren crewneck t-shirt with small navy pony logo on the chest
964484272869.description: White short sleeve Ralph Lauren t-shirt with a ribbed crew neck and a small navy embroidered pony logo on the left chest. A printed Polo Ralph Lauren label is visible inside the neckline.

968451892667.alt_text: Light blue Patagonia hooded shell jacket with navy zips and small logo patch on the chest
968451892667.description: Light blue Patagonia Northwall hooded shell jacket with a full navy front zip, two vertical chest zip pockets and a zip pocket on the sleeve. A small Patagonia logo patch sits on the chest, with elasticated cuffs and a drawcord hood.

969492407302.alt_text: Navy washed Jacob Cohen jeans with leather J patch, blue pocket label and red stitched back pocket detail
969492407302.description: Folded navy jeans in a faded grey-blue wash with a dark leather J logo patch on the waistband and a blue Jacob Cohen Limited Edition label on the back pocket. The pocket has red curved stitching and a blue hang tag is attached at the belt loop.

976896164628.alt_text: Navy Ralph Lauren Polo Bear crewneck sweater with bear in green jacket and jeans knitted on the front
976896164628.description: Navy knit crewneck sweater with a Polo Bear intarsia on the front wearing a green jacket, striped top and blue jeans. Ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, a blue RL monogram near the hem and a Polo Ralph Lauren neck label.

977682146752.alt_text: Black Ralph Lauren glossy hooded puffer jacket with small red pony logo on the chest
977682146752.description: Black glossy quilted puffer jacket with an attached hood, full front zip and a vertical zip chest pocket. A small red Ralph Lauren pony logo sits on the left chest.

978055884848.alt_text: Navy Patagonia fleece vest with full zip, stand collar and bright blue zip pulls
978055884848.description: Navy Patagonia fleece vest with a full-length zip, stand collar and navy binding at the armholes and hem. It has a chest zip pocket with a small logo patch, two lower zip pockets and bright blue zip pulls.

985218088824.alt_text: Navy Patagonia full-zip fleece jacket with stand collar and small logo patch on the chest
985218088824.description: Navy Patagonia fleece jacket with a full-length front zip, stand collar and two zipped hand pockets. A small white logo patch sits on the left chest and a brown swing tag hangs from the collar.
